# Glossary review: Chinese (Traditional) (`zh-TW`)

*Written by `python scripts/intake/glossary_tool.py record`; `check` compares it with a fresh run. Do not edit it.*

Glossary version `1.0.0-draft`. These are DRAFTS until you approve them.

## What to check

1. Is the canonical form the word a trader of this language really uses for the term?
2. Are the other accepted spellings words a trader would also type (a short form, a plural, a verb form)? A question that contains any of them is recognised as containing the term.
3. Does any spelling also mean something else in this language? It would mark an unrelated question.
4. Do the texts below read naturally, say what the English says, and keep each `{name}` placeholder?

## Fixed replies, instant prompts and reason texts

| Key | English | Chinese (Traditional) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| intake.refusal.not_signed_in | Please sign in to ask the AI analyst. | 請先登入，再向 AI 分析師提問。 |
| intake.refusal.tier_required | The AI analyst is part of the Pro plan. | AI 分析師屬於 Pro 方案。 |
| intake.refusal.thread_invalid | This conversation is not available. Start a new one about gold (XAUUSD). | 此對話無法使用。請就黃金（XAUUSD）開始新的對話。 |
| intake.refusal.profile_not_set | Confirm your trading profile first. | 請先確認您的交易檔案。 |
| intake.refusal.quota_insufficient | Your AI analyst allowance is used up for now. Please try again later. | 您的 AI 分析師使用額度暫時已用完。請稍後再試。 |
| intake.refusal.feature_unavailable | The AI analyst is not available yet. | AI 分析師尚未開放。 |
| intake.refusal.question_empty | Type a question about gold (XAUUSD) first. | 請先輸入一個關於黃金（XAUUSD）的問題。 |
| intake.refusal.question_too_long | Your question is too long. Please keep it to {limit} characters or fewer. | 您的問題太長。請控制在 {limit} 個字元以內。 |
| intake.refusal.understanding_failed | That question could not be read just now. Please try again. | 暫時無法讀取這個問題。請重試。 |
| intake.refusal.out_of_scope | This analyst covers gold (XAUUSD) on the M5 and M15 charts only. Ask about those. | 此分析師僅涵蓋 M5 和 M15 圖表上的黃金（XAUUSD）。請就這些提問。 |
| intake.instant.m5 | Explain the current M5 chart | 請解釋目前的 M5 圖表 |
| intake.instant.m15 | Explain the current M15 chart | 請解釋目前的 M15 圖表 |
| intake.reason.data_stale | The market data is out of date, so this sensor has no usable reading. | 市場資料已過期，因此該感測器沒有可用的讀數。 |
| intake.reason.retuning | The chart indicator is being re-tuned, so this reading is less reliable for now. | 圖表指標正在重新校準，因此該讀數暫時不太可靠。 |
| intake.reason.no_setting | No indicator setting is available for this timeframe, so this sensor cannot read it. | 該時間週期沒有指標設定，因此該感測器無法讀取。 |
| intake.reason.detection_mismatch | The indicator found in the data does not match its setting, so treat this reading with caution. | 資料中發現的指標與其設定不一致，請謹慎對待該讀數。 |
| intake.reason.no_stats_at_slot | The statistics for this moment are not available yet, so this reading is out of date. | 此刻的統計資料尚不可用，因此該讀數已過期。 |
| intake.reason.containment_low | The price is not staying inside the channel well enough for a reliable reading. | 價格沒有足夠地保持在通道內，無法得到可靠的讀數。 |
| intake.reason.insufficient_bars | There are not enough closed bars yet for a reliable reading. | 已收盤的K線還不夠，無法得到可靠的讀數。 |
| intake.reason.discontinuity | The bars have gaps or are out of order, so this reading cannot be trusted. | K線存在缺口或順序混亂，因此無法信任該讀數。 |
| intake.reason.sanity_failed | The channel values are impossible, so this reading cannot be trusted. | 通道數值不合常理，因此無法信任該讀數。 |
| intake.reason.upstream_cautionary | {sensor} is cautionary, so this reading is cautionary too. | {sensor} 處於謹慎狀態，因此該讀數也需謹慎對待。 |
| intake.reason.upstream_unavailable | {sensor} has no valid reading, so this one is unavailable. | {sensor} 沒有有效讀數，因此該讀數無法使用。 |
| intake.reason.upstream_stale | {sensor} is out of date, so this one is too. | {sensor} 已過期，因此該讀數也已過期。 |
| intake.reason.mcd0_defect_m5 | The M5 channel does not fit the price well enough, so readings that use it are cautionary. | M5 通道與價格的擬合不夠好，因此使用它的讀數需謹慎對待。 |
| intake.reason.mcd0_defect_m15 | The M15 channel does not fit the price well enough, so readings that use it are cautionary. | M15 通道與價格的擬合不夠好，因此使用它的讀數需謹慎對待。 |
| intake.reason.evaluator_error | This sensor hit an unexpected error and has no reading right now. | 該感測器發生意外錯誤，目前沒有讀數。 |
| intake.reason.modifier_caution | Another sensor adds caution to this reading: {state}. | 另一個感測器為該讀數增加了謹慎提示：{state} |

## Sign-off

Read the tables above, then edit `approval.json` in this folder: set `status` to `APPROVED`, `approved_by` to your name and `approved_on` to the date (YYYY-MM-DD). It holds the SHA-256 of the content you read, so a later change to it puts this area back to PENDING (`python scripts/intake/glossary_tool.py record`). Then run `record` once more so the forms of Chinese (Traditional) are marked `approved` in the glossary.
